cues: During a criterium, racers accelerate out of tight corners while teammates shelter one another from the wind.
On a velodrome, sprinters climb the steep banking, then dive toward the track’s inner line.
A group travels single file, each participant taking a brief turn at the front before dropping back.
At a charity event, a peloton follows marshals through town, collecting stamps at route checkpoints.
During a stage race, a teammate hands a water bottle to the leader without breaking formation.
Each July, spectators line mountain roads, ringing cowbells as a colorful race caravan climbs toward the summit.
